title: MMAR: A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio, Music, and Their Mix
reasoning: The benchmark focuses on audio reasoning across signal, perception, semantic, and cultural layers (e.g., identifying musical periods or Mandarin tones). While it includes an ethical statement regarding data collection and mentions social norms as part of cultural reasoning, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component.
